title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.37481v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned mod

translated_title: 跟随梯度：追溯安全退化至训练数据
translated_abstract: 在指令数据上微调大语言模型（LLMs）可能会悄然削弱其安全性，即使没有任何训练样本看起来有害。由于这种降低安全性的数据看起来是良性的，标准的内容过滤器难以捕捉到它。我们通过开发SimpleLoRIF来解决这一问题，这是一种可扩展的梯度嵌入方法，能够识别其梯度与不安全行为对齐的微调样本。通过简化低秩归因方法并将反向传播限制在最后四个Transformer块，SimpleLoRIF可以嵌入百万量级样本的数据集，将梯度归因从小规模分析工具提升为适用于完整后训练数据集的实用过滤器。我们首先在涌现性失调现象上验证了该方法，发现梯度可以将不安全代码训练数据与微调后出现的广泛有害行为联系起来，在失调模型的梯度空间中AUC高达0.865。
tldr: 本文提出SimpleLoRIF，一种可扩展的梯度嵌入方法，能够识别其梯度与不安全行为对齐的微调样本，从而追溯并过滤导致大语言模型安全退化的训练数据。
